rows.coder_note: p002 and p004 write version R12 (finngen_R12_N14_ACUTERENFAIL; 500,348 individuals), but p003 writes 'FinnGen R12 database (N=412,181)': 412,181 is given as the database N and is exactly the release N of FinnGen R10 (rule H), so two passages disagree. The 8,383 cases and 480,448 controls in p002 are endpoint counts and not a conflict.

Rule I3: ebi-a-GCST90018790 lies inside the registered range GCST90018563-GCST90019002 of the Sakaue 2021 BBJ row (ref 21, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00931-x), but the sentence gives 482,266 individuals as the size of the dataset, which that row (up to 178,726, Japanese) does not allow; 482,266 is the total N of the GWAS, not a subset count (rule H).

p003 cites Sun 2023 (ref 18, several dictionary rows) with '54,219 European participants' and 2,940 proteins. 54,219 is the sample size of no UKB-PPP row, and 'European' with that N does not match exactly one row without conflict (discovery is European with 34,557; the full cohort is multi-ancestry with 52,363), so rule E is not met.
